items.title: Building always-on agents (13 minute read)
items.snippet: Always-on agents, revived by recent advancements, now manage context and act without direct supervision, running on a core loop enhanced with event inboxes, timers, memory, permissions, and outboxes.

items.title: Building strong safety evaluations (23 minute read)
items.snippet: Anthropic emphasizes the importance of robust safety evaluations for AI models, which inform deployment and training decisions.
